metadata.description: A small set of Claude Code skills built for daily use, then generalised for release.

plugins.name: prompt-forge
plugins.description: Model-aware prompt generator and critic. Reads target-model behaviour from dated reference files instead of memory, applies a model-specific transform, and scans for constructs that now return HTTP 400.

plugins.name: context-till
plugins.description: Surfaces token and context waste at the end of each turn. Reports only what its hooks actually measured, never an estimate.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Four standalone skills: entity-naming, sketcher, risk-critic and remediation-planner.
